newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Two Strathcona test drills at Busang completed.
newsitem.headline: Two Strathcona test drills at Busang completed.

text.p: The results of the first two of six test drillings by Canadian consultants Strathcona Mineral Services at the Busang gold site were stored on Thursday in a locked hanger at the East Kalimantan capital of Balikpapan, a spokesman for the Busang partners said.
Strathcona was hired two weeks ago by Canadian exploration company Bre-X Minerals Ltd to conduct an independent survey of the Busang area.
Bre-X shocked the mining community with a statement that there was a possibility that the amount of gold at Busang had been overstated.
It had earlier put gold reserves at some 71 million ounces, which would have made it the biggest find of the century.

A statement from the Indonesian Nusamba Group, one of the partners in Busang, said: "Today, results of the first two drills have arrived in Balikpapan and (been) stored in a locked container in an empty hanger.
"Strathcona has hired an independent security service to guard the drill results."
It said Strathcona would drill a total of six holes at Busang, with the remaining four holes drilled over a seven-day period.
It said the samples would be taken to Australia in mid-April and distributed to three independent laboratories for assaying.
"The results will take approximately two weeks and will be reported in early May," the statement said.
It said geologists from all parties involved were present at the Busang site as observers.

These included Bre-X, with a 45 percent stake, U.S. Freeport-McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc with 15 percent, the Nusamba Group with 30 percent, the government through the Ministry of Mines and Energy with 10 percent, and Strathcona.
The Nusamba statement said the current survey was purely in the hands of Strathcona geologists. --Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
